items.title: 4 Financial Stocks That Kept Raising Dividends Through 2 Historic Crashes
items.summary: Financial stocks are the first to crack when markets panic, yet a handful of them kept handing investors bigger checks through both the 2008 meltdown and the 2020 shock. Four names cleared that bar, and their current yields tell only part of the story.
